claims.claim: We found no detailed report of how federal monitors acted at Georgia polling places; Cobb's elections director said the day "went smoothly" (AJC).

REPORTED As of Nov. 1, the probe had produced no prosecutions, the Justice Department's appeal over the election workers' identities was pending, and the State Election Board was seeking about 1.2 million digital scans of the seized records (AJC).
CBS Atlanta reports the federal 2020 probe is separate.

ON THE MONITORS · Election monitoring is a long-running Justice Department program, and five of the six counties had monitors in 2024; this year the department said it was monitoring all 50 states for the first time, and Fulton's election board chair called this year's deployment "not unusual."
